newsitem.title: USA: CMS raises qtly div 11 pct to $0.30/shr.
newsitem.headline: CMS raises qtly div 11 pct to $0.30/shr.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said Tuesday its board had approved an 11 percent increase in the quarterly dividend, to $0.30 a share from $0.27.
In a press release, CMS said the increase would be effective with the August payment. It did not provide a record date, and company officials could not be reached for comment.
CMS Chairman and Chief Executive Officer William McCormick said in a statement the rate of future dividend growth "should be substantially greater than the average of the utility industry."
He cited the firm's relatively low current payout level and expected earnings growth in both its utility and international energy businesses.
CMS, an international energy company with $4.8 billion in annual sales, owns Consumers Energy, Michigan's largest utility.
Reached later, a CMS spokesman said the dividend is payable August 22, record August 4.
